candidates.issues: Faithful and natural. The title is long but correct.
The title adds «с Nutella», which is not in the source. Otherwise very natural phrasing.
The title «пирог с печеньем для ложки» is awkward and mistranslates the dish. «Проверяйте готовность через 12 минут» loses the sense of ongoing checking.
The title drops 'scoopable'. Otherwise accurate and natural.
Agreement error: «0 шоколадные капли». The 'keep checking' nuance is weakened. The title is acceptable.
The title «пирог с печеньем, которое едят ложкой» misrepresents the dish as a pie with cookies. The rest is good.
